scripts.profile.py:
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
root = p / 'profiles'
root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
metadata = json.loads((p / 'metadata.json').read_text())
cases = ['div_i16_literal_ansifalse', 'no_division_ansitrue']
records = []
for i, variant in enumerate(['before', 'after', 'after', 'before'] * 2):
    binary = Path(metadata['binaries'][variant]['path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == metadata['binaries'][variant]['sha256']
    for case in cases:
        out = root / f'{i:02}-{variant}-{case}'
        out.mkdir()
        for name in ['control', 'ack']:
            os.mkfifo(out / name)
        cmd = ['perf', 'record', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{out}/control,{out}/ack', '-e', 'cycles:u', '-c', '100003', '-o', str(out / 'perf.data'), '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(binary), str(out / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', case]
        env = os.environ | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(out), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution'}
        run = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
        report = subprocess.check_output(['perf', 'report', '--stdio', '--no-children', '--show-nr-samples', '--sort=symbol', '--percent-limit', '0.5', '-t', ';', '-i', str(out / 'perf.data')], text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        (out / 'report.txt').write_text(report)
        capture = json.loads((out / 'capture.json').read_text())
        assert len(capture['results']) == 1 and capture['results'][0]['status'] == 'ok'
        assert capture['results'][0]['probe_value_buffer_mutable'] is False
        records.append({'variant': variant, 'case': case, 'command': cmd, 'environment': {k: env[k] for k in ['DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE']}, 'capture': capture, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'report': report, 'data_path': str(out / 'perf.data')})
        print(i, variant, case, flush=True)
        (p / 'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Execution-only self-cycle profiles of frozen binaries. Four fresh processes per variant/case, period100003. Profile timings are diagnostic and excluded from performance comparisons. No source rebuild.', 'runs': records}, indent=2) + '\n')
scripts.summarize-profiles.py:
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;d=json.loads((p/'profiles.json').read_text());assert len(d['runs'])==16;groups={}
for r in d['runs']:
 total=int(re.search(r'# Samples: ([0-9,]+)',r['report'])[1].replace(',',''))
 assert '# Total Lost Samples: 0' in r['report']
 key=r['variant']+'/'+r['case'];g=groups.setdefault(key,{'processes':0,'samples':0,'categories':{}});g['processes']+=1;g['samples']+=total
 for line in r['report'].splitlines():
  if '%' not in line:continue
  fields=[f.strip() for f in line.split(';')]
  if len(fields)<3:continue
  count=int(fields[1]);symbol=fields[2]
  category='division' if 'arrow_arith::numeric::integer_op<arrow_array::types::Int16Type>' in symbol else 'widening' if 'try_numeric_cast<arrow_array::types::Int16Type, arrow_array::types::Int64Type>' in symbol else 'integer_to_decimal' if 'arrow_cast::cast::integer_decimal_buffer::' in symbol else 'memset' if '__memset' in symbol else 'other_reported'
  g['categories'][category]=g['categories'].get(category,0)+count
for key,g in groups.items():
 assert g['processes']==4
 g['categories']['below_report_threshold']=g['samples']-sum(g['categories'].values());g['percent']={k:n/g['samples']*100 for k,n in g['categories'].items()}
 print(key,g['samples'],{k:round(v,2) for k,v in g['percent'].items()})
(p/'profile-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':'Summed self-cycle sample counts across 4 processes per group. Reports omit individual symbols below 0.5%; unreported samples are retained in their own category. Integer-to-Decimal includes scaling and output writes, not just cache bookkeeping. This coarse sampling cannot attribute a sub-percent difference.','groups':groups},indent=2)+'\n')

method.before: Prior global-gated buffer-reuse experiment, including the earlier infallible integer-to-Decimal optimization.
method.after: Thread-local idle-buffer experiment committed at the baseline commit. Same frozen binaries as the preceding 1.50% observation.

groups.repeat: CPU2, diagnostic ownership probe enabled, 32 processes per variant/case, total256.
groups.no-probe: CPU2, DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN unset so the extra ownership-probe allocation is absent; 16 processes per variant/case, total128.
groups.cpu4: CPU4, ownership probe enabled; 16 processes per variant/case, total128.

method.timing: Same 4 frozen queries, 1048576 rows, batch8192, one partition/current-thread Tokio runtime. Each process contributes the median of 9 fresh-plan executions after 2 warmups. ABBA variant ordering rotates case order. perf FIFO counters cover execution only; full result validation occurs before timing. No retained result in this audit.
method.paired_blocks: For each ABBA block and case, average the two process medians per variant and report 100*(after/before-1). Do not pool CPU/probe protocols. Raw block ratios and exploratory bootstrap intervals are retained.
method.profiles: 16 separate execution-only cycle profiles, 4 processes per variant for SMALLINT and cast-only queries, period100003 on CPU2. All performance measurements finished first. Profiling timings are excluded.
method.assembly: objdump instruction offsets and operands with branch targets made relative within the function, external direct calls named, RIP displacements/comments omitted. Relocation-insensitive shape comparison, not a byte-identical binary or microarchitectural equivalence claim.

block_uncertainty.scope: Exploratory percentile bootstrap of independent ABBA-block mean ratios, fixed seed18144 and10000 resamples. Intervals describe sampled blocks, not a guarantee about other executions. Systematic host/code-layout effects are not captured.
